title: Strip mall dollar store dreams
content: Hi MallWorld Does anyone else have dreams about a Dollar Tree store in a strip mall? It feels geographically close to the mall(s) I always visit in dreams. I had another dream about it last night. It looks nothing like a place I know in real life, it always seems cloudy or rainy outside when I’m in the parking lot. Inside it looks like any given dollar tree store, except maybe a bit larger, always seeming like one of the more chaotic locations. It has the same vibe as the regular mallworld type dreams- the feeling of familiarity, the fact that the dreams are recurring and the people in the dreams seem familiar to the point of recognizing them again and again each time you have the dream. I also sometimes dream about being in the shopping/receiving bays of the actual mall, in the back. Absolutely cluttered with boxes and almost impossible to move through. Along the same lines, I’ve had many dreams about being in the employee hallways behind the stores, in storage areas for goods, and even up on the rafters and catwalks near the skylights. Sometimes there is a thick layer of dust everywhere, like it hasn’t been cleaned properly in god knows how many years. It’s very surreal. I did work retail throughout my college and young adult life, so I am familiar with how these spaces typically look, and yet none of them are the actual places I’ve worked before. Just wondering if anyone else has these dreams as well
